title: Detect gh authentication for repo automation
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. scripts that need gh (ruleset, PR reconcile) check auth up front and give the exact 'gh auth login' step instead of failing midway. Tests zc_gh_auth_auto_*.
